description:
Dojun is a pretty ordinary guy. He’s a laid-back college student with a decent amount of friends and no notable scandals or troubles in his life. On the other hand, Haemin is his exact opposite: a fellow student with zero friends and a scandalous reputation with financial troubles following him wherever he goes. It’s really not the kind of lifestyle Dojun wants to be involved in. And yet, he can’t stop worrying about the perpetually bruised Haemin, which is why Dojun ends up worming his way into Haemin’s life…only to discover that there’s much more to him than the scandals say. Will Dojun be able to find the real Haemin buried under the injuries and rumors? 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: The chapter count includes two bonus chapters.*
